medium.syllabus_scope: First 50% of the ordered practical syllabus: computer fundamentals, OS/file operations and introductory productivity/web tasks.

Questions: Which action changes a folder's name without changing its contents?
Which HTML element inserts an image when a valid source is supplied?
Which software manages hardware resources and services for applications?
Windows is to be installed on a laptop containing irreplaceable files. What should be done before changing partitions?
A Linux command must list files, then enter a directory named reports. Which sequence fits?
What is the usual purpose of BIOS/firmware during startup?
A computer has no usable display after a resolution change. Which recovery attempt is most appropriate first?
In File Explorer, how can a user select several non-adjacent files?
Which command-line command normally changes the current directory?
A file's exact location and size must be checked without opening it. Which feature is appropriate?
Which component provides the main connection platform for CPU, memory and expansion devices?
A page should have a background image while keeping a paragraph readable. Which implementation is best?
A Linux user wants to inspect permissions and file details, including hidden entries, before changing access. Which command is safest?
Which device is primarily an input device?
What is a folder used for?
What does copying a file usually do?
A Windows PC is slow after startup. The user wants evidence about resource use before uninstalling software. What is the best first check?
What should a user enter to open a known website directly from the browser address bar?
A user needs detailed file listings including hidden entries in a Unix shell. Which command is best?
A paragraph's formatting must be reused without copying its text. What is the best tool?
A workstation is shared by several students. Which setup reduces risk of one user's files being changed by another?
Which component executes program instructions?
An installer asks to format a partition that may contain personal files. What is the safest response?
A student accidentally deletes a project folder using normal Windows deletion. Where should they check first?
What is the function of an output peripheral?
Which setting controls vertical space between lines of a paragraph?
What does booting a computer mean?
Which HTML element represents a paragraph?
What is the main role of an operating system?
A shell command fails because a directory name contains spaces. Which correction treats it as one argument?
Options: Back up important files and verify the target partition
Connect a keyboard wirelessly in all cases
Initialize hardware and begin the boot process
Use display recovery/safe mode or revert to a supported resolution
Hold Ctrl while clicking each file
Hold Shift and click the first and last
Set the document title to the image URL
Set the background image in CSS and keep text contrast readable
Place image markup after closing the HTML document
Use the image as the only text content
Creates another copy at the destination
Changes the file into a folder
Moves the only copy and removes the source
Open Task Manager and compare process CPU/memory usage
Give all users full administrator rights
Use separate accounts with least privilege and screen locking
Stop, verify the target disk and back up files before formatting
Continue because setup always protects files
Present processed information to a user or another system
Provide source code compilation in every case
Starting the system and loading the operating system
Store every file on a printer
